in_sanskrit.name: गयना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गमनात् संज्ञा (from the root 'Gam' meaning 'to go', and the suffix '-ana' meaning 'movement' or 'process')

in_hindi.name: गयना
in_hindi.long_meaning: गमनात् (from the root 'Gam' meaning 'to go') और '-ना' (suffix meaning 'process' or 'activity') से स्वरूप जानना (to know)

in_tamil.name: காயணா
in_tamil.long_meaning: கம்மின் அடிகளில் அறிவித்தல் (knowledge derived from movement)

in_marathi.name: Gayana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gayana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who chants or recites the sacred texts. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'gam' meaning 'to go' and 'vidh' meaning 'to know'.
